summary: Family home game for kids 3-7: pretend play, care toddlers, cook & house stories
description:
STORIES JUNIOR GAMES
Gentle pretend play worlds for curious young minds.
Loved by over 300 million families worldwide and awarded for more than a decade, Stories Junior pretend play games invites children to imagine, create, and explore gentle family worlds filled with creativity and care to build their own stories.
Each playhouse is designed for open-ended discovery, where children lead the story, express emotions, and build empathy through imaginative role play.
Every space encourages curiosity, storytelling, and calm exploration in a safe digital environment made for kids in their early childhood.

STORIES JUNIOR: SWEET HOME
A warm family dollhouse full of stories to create.
Stories Junior: Sweet Home (previously Sweet Home Stories) invites kids to join a loving virtual family and discover everyday moments that inspire imagination and care in a cozy playhouse.
Children can take care of other kids, a baby, or a dog; help around the house with different tasks, prepare meals, or simply enjoy quiet family time in each room.
Every routine becomes a new story to tell — a gentle pretend play experience about family, love, empathy, and daily life that fosters imagination and storytelling skills.
Each room in this playhouse feels warm and full of life — with soft sounds, cozy lighting, and small surprises waiting to be discovered, each turning into a new story waiting to be told: setting the table becomes teamwork, bath time turns into laughter, and bedtime is a quiet ritual full of love.
Switch between day and night to unlock pretend play possibilities. As the day turns into night, the home changes too — toys rest, lights dim, and the family gathers to read, relax, and dream together. 
From morning routines to bedtime stories, every moment in this household feels alive. Kids can prepare breakfast together, take care of the baby, feed the dog, and share calm moments that grow into family memories.

DISCOVER THE PLAYHOUSE
Front Yard – Play outdoors, await visitors, or check the mailbox for surprises.
Living Room – Enjoy quality moments with the whole family.
Kitchen – Cook together and set the table for everyone.
Kids’ Bedroom – Clean up the toys and dolls scattered around. Rest, read, or prepare for the next day. 
Parents’ Bedroom – Put the baby to sleep and rest after a long day.
Bathroom – Bathe family members or do the laundry.
Garden – Grow plants or play music with the kids under the sun.

A FAMILY FULL OF HEART
Six unique characters, including a cat, invite kids to create family stories and pretend-play everyday situations.
Feed, bathe, dress, and care for each family member — every action helps nurture imagination, empathy, and understanding of real-life routines.

CREATED FOR PEACEFUL PLAY
• Designed for children ages 2–6 to explore safely and independently.
• Detailed enough to entertain older family members too.
• Private, single-player experience with no chats or online features.
• Works perfectly offline once installed.

EXPAND YOUR HOME STORIES
Stories Junior: Sweet Home is free to download and includes a complete household playhouse with many rooms and activities to explore.
Families can expand the home at any time with a single, safe purchase — make the house even better with new stories to discover.

WHY FAMILIES LOVE STORIES JUNIOR
Families around the world trust Stories Junior for calm, creative pretend play that supports imagination and emotional growth.
Each title offers a gentle toy-box world where children explore family life, storytelling, and empathy at their own pace.
Stories Junior — Calm, creative play for growing minds.
